newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Q1 foreign investment $116.6 mln - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Q1 foreign investment $116.6 mln - ministry.

text.p: Foreign direct investment in Ukraine totalled $116.6 million in the first quarter of this year, the Economy Ministry said on Friday.
The largest investments came from the U.S., Germany and the Netherlands, it said in a statement.
According to the Statistics Ministry, Ukraine has attracted $1.4 billion in foreign investment since independence in 1991. Last year foreign investment totalled about $531 million.
President Leonid Kuchma recently formed a commission he will lead with foreign business leaders, to bring more investment into the cash-strapped former Soviet republic.
The government also announced this week measures to halt corruption by government officials, cited by foreign investors as a major deterrent to doing business in Ukraine.
